cost_estimate: 72 episodes,336 task calls plus logged setups;12–18min collection; total30–45min; about1–1.5GB including features. No training/download/upload.

arms: baseline same-capacity Object with frozen-feature random projections
geometry Object with public RGB-D coarse grid and per-object geometry
models.weights_and_normalization: From sealed RGB-D comparison; both arms already trained. geometry remains candidate, not winner. local_gap excluded.
models.global_baseline: Not included: no comparable frozen same-input global model.

geometry.admission: Deterministic up to128 candidates; geometry-only footprint/clearance/IK/reset; reject all three positions within20mm under any color permutation of old or accepted family. Freeze admitted roots before task rollouts. No outcome/model-based replacement.

templates.recovery_seen6: open+lift H setup; P,L(T),P,L(T),P,C. Same trained order; new geometry. Branch2 overrides gripper-close on first requested L(T), then existing second L(T) can recover.
templates.order_known4: open+lift H+place H setup; L(T),P,C,O. Exact order seen in training.
templates.order_novel4: Same open/empty/H-in-drawer setup as order_known4; C,O,L(T),P. Same action multiset, unseen full and contiguous four-step training order. Branch2 overrides first L(T). No new skill.

prediction_starts.current: h0 then each real observed boundary; no future observations
prediction_starts.one_step: Each actual previous posterior, predict next boundary without next RGB-D
prediction_starts.free_h0: From actual h0, whole 4 or6 action sequence with no future observations
prediction_starts.free_h2: Additional known recovery6 only: observe h0..h2 including grasp outcome, then predict remaining4 actions with no future observations

hold_probe.source: Existing unmodified PhysicalOracle lift verify_stable_completion controls4,8,12; no new controllers/actions/physical holds. Public four-frame windows only.
hold_probe.model_usage: Apply the same pre-lift action prior independently to each probe observation. No hold verb or hold-transition evaluation claimed. Probe posterior never fed into main trajectory.
hold_probe.positive_denominator: Requested target truly Held continuously at every recorded control from probe4 through8 or8 through12. Each eligible interval counted; report positive frames, eligible runs, failures and absent/incomplete probes. Family/episode correlation explicit.
hold_probe.In_denominator: Non-target H truly InDrawer throughout corresponding control interval; report retained relations separately.

scoring.per_step: All-three Held, all-three In, drawer, conjunction; invalid GT counted and shown, never silently dropped
scoring.whole: Every observed boundary or every predicted boundary correct; report branch and template separately
scoring.semantic_checks: Requested T Held on lift; T InDrawer and empty hand on placement; non-target H InDrawer; actual execution/refusal/success logged
scoring.close: All close calls remain in full metrics, plus separate close status/three-class breakdown; no further close-feature search
scoring.retention: Stable true Held/In at task boundaries and control probes; positive and prior-correct denominators explicit
scoring.family: Per-family outcomes; paired family bootstrap2000 for geometry-minus-baseline, no acceptance gate invented
scoring.failure_policy: No replacement or selective dropping. Partial collection reported as partial, preferably complete families; no test-to-training or threshold selection.
